title: 第23章 好酒，好酒啊！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚大结局全文免费阅读
content_zh: 唐逸走上前，抬手拍了拍李有财肩膀上的褶皱，平静开了口。“李有财，你是不是觉得我拿不出美酒啊？”“真是不好意思，美酒，我真的有。”李有财猛地抬起头，老眼瞪大。不可能！颜霜玉说了，这家伙就是个穷光蛋，怎么可能有什么美酒？“音儿。”唐逸抬手打了个响指，唐音立即从他身后露出脑袋：“哥哥，我来了，噢，美酒我拿来了，给你。”众人这才注意到，唐音手中正抱着两小坛酒。唐逸从唐音手中接过酒坛，将一坛递给魏海，道：“魏兄，这就是我迎客楼参赛的美酒。”“不可能！”李有财当场跳了起来，指着唐逸手中的酒坛声嘶力竭：“海爷，你别上当，他就是唐家的一个小丑，怎么可能会弄出什么美酒出来。”“唐逸，我告诉你，参赛美酒必须得是自家酿造，否则就是属于作弊，后果你可承担不起！”“而且，这包装粗陋不堪，好酒能是这包装？海爷你别上当了。”魏海看着手中的酒坛，也觉得包装太过随意了。他抬头看向唐逸，唐逸走到酒桌取下一个酒杯，随即撕开了酒坛的封口。顷刻间，一股浓郁的酒香就在众人鼻息下萦绕，让魏海都不自觉吸了吸鼻子。“魏兄，尝一下。”唐逸倒了一杯酒，递给了魏海。魏海接过酒杯，在鼻息下过了一遍，随即仰头一口入喉。“咳咳……”酒水刚入喉，他直接弯着腰一阵咳嗽，一张脸也像是被火烧一样，憋得通红。妈的，这什么酒？怎么这么辣！但，好爽！看到他的样子，李有财苍白的脸色瞬间恢复了血色，以为唐逸的酒有问题，当即冷声呵斥：“唐逸，你竟敢谋害海爷，你……”然而，话没说完，就看到魏海猛地抬起头，手中酒杯向唐逸递了过去，脸上也有些纠结。“呃，那个，小老板……能再来一杯不？”李有财：“？？？”李有财顿时瞪大双眼，难以置信。所以魏海之所以咳嗽，不是因为酒有问题，而是因为酒太烈了？这怎么可能？颜霜玉不是说了吗？唐逸不可能酿出美酒的啊！“最后一杯，这可是我等下要孝敬魏老的，今日的事有点误会，的确应该登门道歉……”唐逸再度给魏海倒了一杯酒。本来他弄蒸馏酒，除了要打广告外，另外一个原因就是想要用酒，和天香楼的总管魏渊攀点关系。而天香楼的总管魏渊，嗜酒如命。原本还想找个什么理由，却没想到颜霜玉连理由都帮他找好了。魏海听唐逸开封的那壶酒，是准备给师父的，顿时有些震惊：“小老板，这酒不是你用来参加斗酒大会的吗？在斗酒大会之前，酒是保密的。”“你这可就是自己泄密了！”唐逸笑道：“酒香不怕巷子深，我对自己的酒，很有信心。”“小老板倒是自信，就冲你这两杯酒，等下师父那里我给你说说话。”魏海大笑一声，看了一眼李有财，当场把李有财吓得瑟瑟发抖。“小老板，我也不喜欢吃里扒外的人，需要帮忙吗？”唐逸摇了摇头，道：“不用，我自己能搞定！”魏海笑着点点头，带着人离开了酒楼。魏海一走，李有财脸色簌簌变白，他盯着唐逸依旧难以置信：“不可能，你怎么可能能弄出有资格参加斗酒大会的美酒？”“颜霜玉说了，你就是个废物，你不可能有的！”唐逸淡淡扫了一眼李有财，脸上看不出一点情绪，然而他越是没有情绪，李有财就恐惧。他答应颜霜玉贿赂魏海，不全是因为相信颜霜玉，而是他在心底也瞧不上唐逸。一个能随意被下人踩踏的废物，能翻出多大的浪花来？结果，唐逸现在举手间就将他和颜霜玉联手设的局破了。“废物？你们对我是真一无所知啊！”唐逸轻笑一声，随即伸手入怀，抓出了一个包裹丢在桌上。啪的一声，包袱散开，露出了里面白花花的银子。足有两百两，都是碎银子。看到银子，一众迎客楼的小厮和厨师都是眼前一亮，齐齐看向唐逸。唐逸脚一勾，拉过来一把椅子坐下，靠着椅子道：“听好了，现在宣布两件事。”“第一，涨工钱，以后迎客楼员工每月基本工钱五两银子，奖金，全勤，业绩另算。”“第二，从现在开始，开除李有财，李有财不再是迎客楼掌柜。”“第三，愿意留下来的人，把李有财打残丢出去！”“……”听到唐逸的话，所有小厮顿时都震惊了。“什么？每个月五两？天爷爷，足足比以前高了几十倍啊！”“四少……不，老板，这是真的吗？真的每个月都有五两银子？”“哈哈，每个月五两，我就能娶个好媳妇了，干个几年，岂不是还能在京城买房了！”“……”大厅所有人顿时激动起来，看向李有财的目光，已经像是在看白花花的银子。之前他们没少被李有财打压和克扣工钱，早就想打他一顿了，现在有四少坐镇，还怕什么？“唐逸，你敢！”“我可是夫人的人，你敢动我，夫人饶不了你！”李有财脸色煞白，连连后退。“哦？我很怕颜霜玉马？”唐逸随意挥了挥手，拉着唐音出了门。一群迎客楼的小二和厨师，直接向着李有财扑了过去，拳脚疾风骤雨般落在李有财的身上。“啊……你们敢……别打，打死人了，我错了……”李有财当场将掌柜打得鬼哭狼嚎。直到将李有财打得鼻青脸肿满身血，两个小厮财拖着李有财丢出了迎客楼。而这时，唐逸已经带着唐音来到天香楼侧面。在侧面的老槐树下，摆放着一张靠椅，靠椅上正坐着一个白发苍苍的老者。而老者身后，站着的正是之前在天香楼的魏海。“晚辈唐逸，见过前辈。”唐逸恭敬行礼。“音音见过爷爷。”唐音直接跪在地上，磕了一个头。爷爷？老太监不理唐逸，但看到唐音，嘴角顿时有笑容溢出，招了招手让唐音起来，走到了他的面前。“小家伙，叫什么名字？”老太监抬手揉了揉唐音的脑袋，目光不经意间瞥到唐音腰间的白色玉佩，揉着唐音的手不由轻微僵了下。“爷爷，我叫唐音，这是哥哥亲手给你酿的酒，送给你。”唐音双手捧着酒坛，眼睛弯成月牙：“哥哥说了，这是天下一等一的好酒，整个天下的好酒都没有哥哥这坛子酒好。”一边说，唐音一边拉开了封盖。顷刻间，一股浓郁醇厚的酒香就在空气中传开。老太监本来以为唐逸利用妹妹跟他套近乎，但闻到这个酒香，他小眼睛瞪大，几乎下意识地咽了咽口水。好酒！好酒啊！
content_en: Tang Yi stepped forward, raised his hand and patted the wrinkles on Li Youcai's shoulders, and spoke calmly."Li Youcai, do you think I can't bring you wine?" "I'm so sorry, I really have wine." Li Youcai suddenly raised his head, his eyes widening.impossible!Yan Shuangyu said, this guy is a pauper, how can he have any fine wine?"Yin'er." Tang Yi raised his hand and snapped his fingers. Tang Yin immediately showed his head from behind him: "Brother, I'm here. Oh, I brought the wine for you." Only then did everyone notice that Tang Yin was holding two small jars of wine in his hands.Tang Yi took the wine jar from Tang Yin's hand, handed one to Wei Hai, and said, "Brother Wei, this is the wine for the competition in my guest house." "Impossible!" Li Youcai jumped up on the spot, pointed at the wine jar in Tang Yi's hand and shouted hoarsely: "Hai Ye, don't be fooled, he is just a clown from the Tang family, how could he do anything?"Tang Yi, let me tell you, the wine must be brewed at home, otherwise it is cheating, and you can't afford the consequences!""Besides, this packaging is crude. How can a good wine be packaged like this?"Wei Hai looked at the wine jar in his hand and felt that the packaging was too casual.He looked up at Tang Yi. Tang Yi walked to the wine table, took down a wine glass, and then tore the seal off the wine jar.In an instant, a strong aroma of wine lingered under everyone's breath, making Wei Hai sniff unconsciously."Brother Wei, have a taste." Tang Yi poured a glass of wine and handed it to Wei Hai.Wei Hai took the wine glass, passed it through his nose, and then raised his head and took a sip into his throat."Ahem..." As soon as the drink entered his throat, he bent over and coughed, and his face turned red as if it was on fire.Damn it, what kind of wine is this?Why is it so spicy!But, it’s so cool!Seeing his appearance, Li Youcai's pale face instantly regained color. He thought there was something wrong with Tang Yi's wine, and immediately scolded him coldly: "Tang Yi, how dare you murder Hai Ye, you..." However, before he finished speaking, he saw Wei Hai suddenly raised his head and handed the wine glass to Tang Yi, with some tangles on his face."Uh, um, little boss...can you have another drink?" Li Youcai: "???" Li Youcai's eyes widened in disbelief.So the reason why Wei Hai coughed was not because there was something wrong with the wine, but because the wine was too strong?How is this possible?Didn’t Yan Shuangyu say that?It's impossible for Tang Yi to brew fine wine!"The last drink, this is what I want to honor Mr. Wei later. There was a bit of a misunderstanding about what happened today, and I really should come to apologize..." Tang Yi poured another glass of wine for Wei Hai.Originally, besides advertising, he wanted to make distilled liquor. Another reason was that he wanted to use the liquor and establish a relationship with Wei Yuan, the manager of Tianxiang Tower.And Wei Yuan, the manager of Tianxiang Tower, is addicted to alcohol.He originally wanted to find a reason, but he didn't expect that Yan Shuangyu even found a reason for him.Wei Hai was shocked when he heard that the pot of wine that Tang Yi opened was for the master: "Little boss, didn't you use this wine to participate in the wine fight? Before the wine fight, the wine is kept secret." "You have leaked the secret yourself!" Tang Yi said with a smile:"The aroma of wine is not afraid of the depth of the alley. I am very confident in my wine." "The little boss is quite confident. I will give you these two glasses of wine. I will talk to you later when the master comes." Wei Hai laughed loudly and glanced at Li Youcai, who was so frightened that he trembled on the spot."Little boss, I don't like people who eat too much. Do you need help?" Tang Yi shook his head and said, "No, I can handle it myself!" Wei Hai nodded with a smile and left the restaurant with others.As soon as Wei Hai left, Li Youcai's face turned pale. He stared at Tang Yi, still in disbelief: "Impossible, how could you make wine that is qualified to participate in the drinking competition?" "Yan Shuangyu said, you are a waste, you can't have it!" Tang Yi glanced at Li Youcai, with no emotion on his face. However, the more emotionless he became, the more fearful Li Youcai became.He agreed to Yan Shuangyu's bribe to Wei Hai, not entirely because he believed in Yan Shuangyu, but because he despised Tang Yi in his heart.How much trouble can a trash that can be trampled on by servants at will make waves?As a result, Tang Yi broke the trap he and Yan Shuangyu had set up with a single move of his hands."Trash? You really know nothing about me!" Tang Yi chuckled, then reached into his arms, grabbed a package and threw it on the table.With a snap, the bundle fell apart, revealing the white money inside.There were two hundred taels, all broken silver.Seeing the silver, the eyes of all the waiters and chefs in the reception building lit up, and they all looked at Tang Yi.Tang Yi hooked his feet, pulled a chair over and sat down. He leaned on the chair and said, "Listen up, I'm going to announce two things now." "First, the salary will be increased. From now on, the basic salary of Yinggulou employees will be five taels of silver per month. Bonuses, perfect attendance, and performance will be calculated separately.""Second, from now on, Li Youcai will be fired. Li Youcai will no longer be the shopkeeper of Yingke Building." "Third, anyone who is willing to stay will have Li Youcai maimed and thrown out!" "..." Hearing Tang Yi's words, all the servants were shocked."What? Five taels a month? Grandpa Tian, ​​it's dozens of times higher than before!" "Four Young Masters... No, boss, is this true? Do you really have five taels of silver every month?" "Haha, with five taels a month, I can marry a good wife. If I work for a few years, I can buy a house in the capital!" "..." Everyone in the hall suddenly became excited. They looked at Li Youcai as if they were looking at white money.They had been suppressed and deducted from wages by Li Youcai many times before, and they had long wanted to beat him up. Now that the Fourth Young Master was in charge, what were they afraid of?"Tang Yi, how dare you!" "I am Madam's, if you dare to touch me, Madam will not spare you!" Li Youcai's face turned pale and he backed away repeatedly."Oh? I'm afraid of Yan Shuang Yu Ma?" Tang Yi waved his hand casually and pulled Tang Yin out of the door.A group of waiters and chefs from the reception building rushed towards Li Youcai, and their fists and kicks fell on Li Youcai like a storm."Ah... How dare you... stop beating me. I'll kill someone. I was wrong..." Li Youcai beat the shopkeeper until he howled like a ghost.After beating Li Youcai until his nose was bruised, his face was swollen and his body was covered with blood, the two young men dragged Li Youcai and threw him out of the reception building.At this time, Tang Yi had already brought Tang Yin to the side of Tianxiang Tower.Under the old locust tree on the side, there is an armchair, and sitting on the armchair is a gray-haired old man.Behind the old man, standing was none other than Wei Hai, who was in Tianxiang Tower before."Junior Tang Yi, I have met my senior." Tang Yi said respectfully
